scope_guards: Visibility from a protected landscape is not automatically significant harm.
Location in the setting is not the same as location within the boundary.
A management-plan objective is not a development consent.
A duty assessment is not a planning decision.
Planning permission is not delivered mitigation.
Planting completion is not established landscape mitigation.
A monitoring plan is not measured landscape outcome.
No score or promotion is written without exact boundary, assessment, decision, mitigation and monitoring evidence.
